title: 6.1 Properties of Exponents

icans: I can use zero and negative exponents.
I can use the properties of exponents to simplify expressions.
I can use the properties of exponents with scientific notation.

blocks.p: Going down the table, divide by 2 each time. Keep the pattern going.
Write each as a product of x’s, then count:   x² · x³ = ________________________ = x<sup>__</sup>      x⁵/x² = ________________________ = x<sup>__</sup>
